import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    a,b,e0,e1,A,B,c1,c2,c3,d1 = [params[i] for i in range(10)]
    ph=a*t+b*t*t
    C=np.cos(ph); S=np.sin(ph)
    return e0 + e1*t + A*C + B*S + c1*v + c2/v + c3*np.arctan(v) + d1*v*S
